title: Positions paid more in overtime than in regular pay, outside the City payroll
question: At the San Francisco bodies outside the City payroll, which positions were paid more in overtime than in regular pay?
finding: 444 position-years from 2019 to 2025 had overtime at least equal to regular pay of $40,000 or more: BART 440, City College of San Francisco (Community College District) 3, Golden Gate Bridge, Highway and Transportation District 1. At BART the commonest positions are Train Operator (69), Senior Operations Foreworker (50), Electrician (47). Largest: Electrical Foreworker (BART, 2021), overtime $299,931 on regular pay of $114,840.
how: State Controller raw export: rows with regular pay of $40,000 or more and overtime at least as large. The $40,000 floor keeps out part-year rows.
limits: Overtime is pay for hours worked; agencies with vacancies or round-the-clock posts fill shifts this way, and labor agreements set the rules. The export has no hours, so whether the hours are plausible for one person cannot be tested here.
